title: Migration is idempotent: re-running on an already-migrated tenant is a no-op
preconds: Test tenant where migration has already completed successfully.
steps:
1. Capture the current role_v2_id for every user.
2. Run the migration command (without --dry-run).
3. Re-capture role_v2_id for every user.
4. Diff pre- vs post-run.
5. Spot-check users who were on custom roles before the second run.
expected:
Step 4: No role_v2_id changes.
Step 5: Custom-role users are unchanged. Re-running migration is safe.
